description: This PHP class 'LocalizationDao' provides database access methods for managing localization-related entities such as languages, translation strings, import errors, and groups within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for searching, counting, saving, updating, and deleting localization data, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: LocalizationDao
classes.description: Data access object class for localization entities, providing CRUD and search functionalities through Doctrine ORM in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Returns an array of language entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getI18NLanguagePaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for languages based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of languages matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns existing language IDs matching the provided list.

methods.name: saveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Persists a new or updated language entity to the database.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Fetches normalized translation strings with source, note, and target, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslationsForExport
methods.description: Fetches normalized translation data suitable for export, including version and unit info.

methods.name: getTranslationsQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper with applied filters for translation search.

methods.name: getTranslationsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of translations matching filter parameters.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedLangString
methods.description: Saves or updates multiple translation entities in bulk.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStrings
methods.description: Persists an array of import error entities.

methods.name: getImportErrorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of import errors based on search filters.

methods.name: getImportErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of import errors matching search filters.

methods.name: getImportErrorQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query builder wrapper for import error search with applied filters.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes import errors for specific language and string IDs.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLanguageAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes import errors for a specific language and employee number.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Searches for localization groups based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for groups based on search filters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Counts the number of groups matching filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Marks specified language entities as removed.

methods.name: getLangStringById
methods.description: Retrieves an I18N language string entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Finds a language string entity by its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Fetches an I18N error entity by its name.

methods.name: getI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Finds an I18N group entity by its name.
